snippet.title: Pedal Rebel VR - Official Open Alpha Trailer | Upload VR Showcase 2025
snippet.description: Pedal Rebel VR is an adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience. Check out the Pedal Rebel VR trailer to see the game in action. Pedal Rebel VR will be available on Meta Quest and Steam VR in 2025, and an open alpha is out now, July 11 to August 11, 2025.
